criteria.outcome: The blue rock volumes feel deliberately shaped and softly finished, with readable large planes, a confident broad silhouette and clear separation of the two masses. Foliage has legible thick leaf volumes and purposeful layering rather than a few tiny segmented rods. Native construction may be rebuilt, with root-approved functional size and clearance retained.

Retain blue stones, green foliage and three cyan guide marks. Approach the target's clear luminous blue and layered yellow-green highlights while keeping lower planes blue and readable, avoiding navy-black holes. Warm accents may enrich edge turns without shifting the identity or making the guide marks disappear.

Broad soft value transitions reveal native form and create a crafted cartoon finish. Highlights should have controlled width and reflect actual volume; avoid thin blown seams, hard black patches and a permanently favored horizontal light direction. All four facings should feel equally intentional under one coherent lighting contract.

A restrained mineral finish and succulent/kelp-like thick green leaves should share the global reference's polished, soft cartoon family. Large readable detail is more valuable than tiny noise. Three separate cyan markers need clean edges and coherent native thickness/bevel if used; do not copy target halos or dark outlines.

At registered logical size and actual phone scene scale, read two blue rock masses, meaningful green growth, three detached cyan marks and transparent lane space. The E/W silhouettes need a coherent foliage cluster; source occlusion is not an aesthetic requirement. Decoration must retain readable spacing rather than merge into indistinct colored dots.

All required facings and every ambient frame must avoid clipping, halos, black dead spots, coplanar flicker, exposed mechanical seams, detached foliage, abrupt normals, visible interpenetration defects and opaque background/ground tiles. Preserve transparent frame space and ground role, with any below-ground original penetration treated as a measured contact condition rather than a full-cell floor rule.

The ambient animation reads as calm natural foliage movement rooted to the flank. Stones and guide marks stay stable; foliage retains deliberate overlap and attachment across all12 frames, with no popping or jump at the frame11->0 wrap. Preserve12 unique runtime frames at12fps, one-second loop and true frame13 closure; native channels may be rebuilt only with equivalent required behavior and bound evidence.

technicalSeparation: Camera/frame/root/sourceScale/atlas order and required views/timing are immutable registration requirements. Existing mesh topology, part counts, exact target pixels and the source's weak silhouette are not. Actual raw authored and evaluated geometry measurements are separate evidence for ROOT's design-budget reconciliation; they are not automatically new exact size locks.
evidenceBar: Required actual native and current-consumer media plus trustworthy technical measurements must be inspected. Missing evidence is needs_evidence. Preparation does not approve any future candidate.
